description: This file defines a Java class 'SubSupervisor' which is an Akka actor responsible for supervising actors handling subscriptions within an Eclipse Ditto pub/sub system. It manages child actors such as 'SubUpdater' and 'AcksUpdater', coordinates their lifecycle, and handles messages related to subscription management, acknowledgements, and actor termination.

classes.name: SubSupervisor
classes.description: An Akka actor that supervises subscription-related child actors, manages their lifecycle, and handles message routing for a pub/sub subscription system.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static method to create Props for a SubSupervisor actor with specified constructor parameters.
